title: [Bug]: TypeError is raised in BGP tests when community is not defined on EOS devices by traffic shift
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Issue Description

If no community is advertised for a route, `parse_routes_on_neighbours` will configure last routes `received_community` as `[]` which causes `TypeError`

```
    def verify_loopback_route_with_community(dut_hosts, duthost, neigh_hosts, ip_ver, community):
        ...
        routes_on_all_nbrs = parse_routes_on_neighbors(duthost, neigh_hosts, ip_ver)
        for hostname, routes in list(routes_on_all_nbrs.items()):
            ...
            for prefix, received_community in list(routes.items()):
                ...
>               nbr_prefix_community_set.add(received_community)
E               TypeError: unhashable type: 'list'
...
received_community = []
```

### Results you see

TypeError is raised due to a bug which allows an empty/non-configured community to be a list when it should be a string.

### Results you expected to see

non-configured/empty community should be an empty string and not an empty list, which would ensure unhandled TypeError is not raised, allowing test to continue.

### Is it platform specific

generic
